_readme: All balance numbers. n = wave number (starts at 1), level = upgrade level (starts at 0). Formulas are in Assets/Scripts/Balance.cs (class Formulas).

waves._formulas: count = min(maxCount, baseCount + floor(countPerWave*(n-1))) | health = baseHealth * healthGrowth^(n-1) | speed = min(maxSpeed, baseSpeed + speedPerWave*(n-1)) | damagePerSecond = baseDamage * damageGrowth^(n-1) | coinsPerKill = max(1, round(baseCoins * coinGrowth^(n-1)))

_upgradeFormulas: value = baseValue + valuePerLevel*level | cost = round(baseCost * costGrowth^level) | maxLevel 0 = unlimited. Level 0 values are the tower's starting stats.
